_meta.description: Stage 2 (Trained) for the Anaplan Overview foundational journey. Five content blocks: Anaplan Story & Vision, Connected Planning Narrative, Platform-at-a-glance, Partner Ecosystem & Pathways, Customer Success Patterns. High-level only — deep platform fluency lives in the separate Anaplan Platform foundational journey.
_meta.boundary_with_stage_3: End of Stage 2: resource understands what Anaplan does as a company, the Connected Planning narrative they will use across customer engagements, the high-level platform shape, and the partner ecosystem they are joining. They have NOT yet been credentialed. Stage 3 is the comprehension check + persona pathway declaration.

_note: Stage 2 task structure is FIXED. Asset content is the canonical Anaplan Overview content set.
name: Trained
description: Resource gains foundational understanding of Anaplan as a company, the Connected Planning narrative, the platform at a high level, the partner ecosystem and pathways, and recurring customer success patterns. Universal content — same for every persona.

blocks.name: Anaplan Story & Vision
blocks.description: Who Anaplan is, where it came from, where it's going.

blocks.name: Connected Planning Narrative
blocks.description: The conceptual frame every partner uses with customers.

blocks.name: Platform Overview
blocks.description: What the Anaplan platform does at a high level. Deep platform fluency lives in the Anaplan Platform foundational journey.

blocks.name: Partner Ecosystem & Pathways
blocks.description: How the partner program works, certification ladders, and where each persona's journey leads.

blocks.name: Customer Success Patterns
blocks.description: Recurring patterns of how customers transform planning with Anaplan.

tasks.title: Anaplan Story & Vision
tasks.description: Recording covering Anaplan as a company — origin, mission, leadership, and current strategic direction. Frames why a partner resource is joining the ecosystem.

tasks.title: Connected Planning narrative
tasks.description: Webcast introducing the Connected Planning conceptual frame — what makes planning 'connected', how it differs from siloed planning, and the customer outcomes it enables. The narrative every partner resource uses to frame Anaplan's value across roles.

tasks.title: Anaplan Platform Overview (high-level)
tasks.description: Deck or recording covering the Anaplan platform at a navigational level: what a workspace is, what a model is, what the user experience looks like, and the major product modules. Stays at the orientation depth; deep platform fluency is the Anaplan Platform foundational journey (a separate prereq for Delivery and Pre-Sales).

tasks.title: Partner Ecosystem & Pathways
tasks.description: Guide covering how the Anaplan partner program is structured (Strategic / Specialist / App Builder paths), the certification ladders, the role-to-pathway map (Sales → Sales Foundations → per-app Sales journeys; Pre-Sales → Pre-Sales Foundations → per-app Pre-Sales journeys; Delivery → Anaplan Platform → per-app Delivery journeys), and where this Anaplan Overview journey routes the resource on completion.

tasks.title: Customer Success Patterns
tasks.description: Recording walking through 3-5 recurring patterns of how customers transform planning with Anaplan — typical pain points, transformation arcs, business outcomes. Concrete examples that bring the Connected Planning narrative to life.

gates.description: Manager name, email, and role populated in resource profile (carry-over from Stage 1; REQUIRED to exit Stage 2)

_estimated_effort_total_note: Lighter than per-application Stage 2 (~4h-5h) because foundational content is high-level only — depth lives in subsequent journeys.

_per_product_authoring_obligations.description: Anaplan Overview is foundational, not per-product. The 'authoring obligations' here are the canonical assets that need to exist (one set, not per-product like the per-application templates).
